address: 10 Stoney Street, Borough Market, London, SE1 9AD, United Kingdom
bio: When negotiating the plethora of eateries around Borough Market, be sure not to miss this popular spot offering a taste of authentic Sri Lankan cooking. The Tamil region of northern Sri Lanka is the largest inspiration for the menu, with dishes providing satisfying flavours and well-balanced spicing. It’s a busy place, so there’s a suitable buzz in the air – and the knowledgeable service team are on hand with suggestions to suit your palate and appetite....
